info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Combination Management API
info.description: The Product Combination Management API enables businesses to dynamically update and manage product combinations within their banking account offerings. This endpoint allows for the patching of existing product combination configurations, ensuring that financial institutions can efficiently tailor their offerings to meet customer demands. Typical consumers include banking administrators and application developers integrating product management functionalities. Use cases encompass modifying features or terms of product bundles to enhance customer satisfaction and streamline account management processes.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific product combination identified by its unique ID. Use this endpoint to modify attributes such as pricing, availability, or specifications.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the properties of a product combination for the specified product ID. The JSON object should contain the fields that require updates following the defined schema.
